column1: # Feature manifest: PD2 game-controller (gamepad) support.  Manual decisions, one reason per row.
# Columns: address <TAB> role <TAB> confidence <TAB> evidence <TAB> reason [<TAB> name]
# Roles: section | core | shared | config | hook | hook-record | state | config-key | string | dependency
#   (see tools/features/extract_feature.py).  Function rows of every role are in the order the package prints them.
# Evidence abbreviations: imp:X = calls import X; str:"..." = uses the string; cfg:key = reads/writes the settings global;
